6. NEWS.md Entry

## New features

### Version Management
* `boilerplate_list_files()` - List all database files including timestamped and backup versions
* `boilerplate_import_enhanced()` - Import specific versions, latest timestamps, or backups
* `boilerplate_restore_backup()` - Restore databases from backup files
* Improved workflow for managing multiple database versions

7. Examples to Add

In Examples Directory

Create inst/examples/version-management-example.R:

# Version Management Example
library(boilerplate)

# List available files
files <- boilerplate_list_files()

# Import latest timestamped version
db_latest <- boilerplate_import_enhanced(latest = TRUE)

# Work with specific versions
db_v1 <- boilerplate_import_enhanced(version = "20240115_143022")

# Restore from backup
db_restored <- boilerplate_restore_backup(
  category = "methods",
  restore = TRUE
)
